item.title: Risk Management and Inter-Bank Dealings - Foreign Exchange Risk Reserve
item.description: Authorised Dealers Category - I (AD Category - I) banks are hereby informed that the Reserve Bank has revised the guidelines on Foreign Exchange Risk Reserve.

item.title: Section 42(1) of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 - Change in Daily Minimum Cash Reserve Maintenance Requirement
item.description: All Scheduled Commercial Banks are advised that daily minimum CRR maintenance requirement stands revised under Section 42(1) of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.
